body.message:
I hope you are doing well.

My name is Ismail Adebisi, and I am reaching out on behalf of  Semakula Technical and Cleaning Services, a professional cleaning company based in Dubai. We specialize in providing reliable, high-quality cleaning services for holiday homes, vacation rentals, and serviced apartments.

We understand that cleanliness is one of the most important factors in achieving excellent guest reviews. Our experienced and dedicated cleaning team is committed to ensuring every property is cleaned to the highest standard before each guest’s arrival.

Our services include:

Holiday home turnover cleaning
Deep cleaning
Move-in and move-out cleaning
Linen and bed preparation (if required)
Flexible scheduling, including weekends and same-day turnovers
Professional, trustworthy, and detail-oriented cleaners
We would be delighted to partner with your company and help maintain your properties to the highest standards. Whether you manage a few units or a large portfolio, we are ready to provide dependable and consistent cleaning services tailored to your needs.

We would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how we can support your operations. Please let us know if you would be interested in a meeting or a trial service.

Thank you for your time and consideration. We look forward to the possibility of working with you.

Kind regards,

Ismail Adebisi

Semakula Technical and Cleaning Services 
Phone: +971 52 198 1437
Email: ismailshina@yahoo.com
